descriptions.w3d_stream_slot_open: Claims a free streaming slot, gives it a fresh non-colliding stream id, and returns the id or -1 when all five are busy.
descriptions.w3d_stream_slot_find: Returns the table index of the in-use streaming slot with the given id, or -1.
descriptions.w3d_stream_unlock: Drops one level of the streaming table lock and releases the underlying lock at depth zero.
descriptions.w3d_stream_lock: Takes one level of the streaming table lock, acquiring the underlying lock on first entry.
descriptions.w3d_stream_member_construct_801e3f00: Registers the streaming subsystem object as the global instance.
descriptions.w3d_stream_member_destroy_801e3f0c: Clears the global streaming subsystem instance and optionally frees the object.
descriptions.w3d_stream_member_open_801e3f3c: Initialises all five streaming slots with aligned buffers and hardware voices, and resets the id counter and lock.
descriptions.w3d_stream_member_close_801e4020: Frees the hardware voice and buffer of each of the five streaming slots.
descriptions.w3d_stream_open_mono: Opens a mono audio stream: claims a slot, prepares it and starts the first asynchronous disc read; returns the id.
descriptions.w3d_stream_slot_play: Starts the hardware voice of an open streaming slot once.
descriptions.w3d_stream_play: Starts playback of a stream id and of its linked left/right channel slots.
descriptions.w3d_stream_is_open: Returns whether the given stream id refers to an open slot.
descriptions.w3d_stream_mute: Sets the voice volume of a stream and its linked channels to zero; returns whether the id was found.
descriptions.w3d_stream_unmute: Restores the voice volume of a stream and its linked channels from its description; returns whether found.
descriptions.w3d_stream_close: Stops a stream and its linked channels, closing or cancelling their disc reads and freeing the slots.
descriptions.w3d_stream_set_mix: Applies mix settings to the voices of a stream and its right channel.
descriptions.w3d_stream_slot_finish: Stops a slot's voice and closes its file, or flags it for closing when a disc read is still pending.
descriptions.w3d_stream_voice_callback_801e4928: Voice playback callback: refills the next half of the stream buffer when playback crosses it, or finishes a stopped slot.
